scenes.title: 412 cups at 8 am
scenes.purpose: Open on the one number that makes a cafe owner care, and set the poster identity (condensed numerals, one red rule).
scenes.viewerShouldNotice: 412 landing by 1.4s with the red rule beneath it.
scenes.focalPoint: Giant number, upper-left of the column
scenes.motionWhy: Counting up makes the viewer wait for the final figure, which is the point.

transitionOut.motivation: Slats start the chart as a rule sheet being drawn.

scenes.first2s: Frame 0: the 560 px counter numeral already on the light ground; it counts up to 412 by 1.3 s, the red rule draws at 1.0 s and the label words rise in.

scenes.title: Cups by hour
scenes.purpose: Show the whole day so the 8 am number is read as a peak against the afternoon lull, not an isolated stat.
scenes.viewerShouldNotice: The 8 am bar is the longest and the only red one; the others dim by 3s.
scenes.focalPoint: Six horizontal bars, middle of the column
scenes.heroMove: Bars grow along a shared baseline
scenes.motionWhy: Bar length IS the data; the dimming then isolates the peak.

transitionOut.motivation: Light slats hand over to the ink slab for the instruction.

scenes.title: Staff for 8 am
scenes.purpose: Turn the chart into the decision the viewer can act on.
scenes.viewerShouldNotice: 8 AM in red as the middle line.
scenes.focalPoint: Three stacked lines filling the column
scenes.heroMove: Masked line reveal rising from the baseline
scenes.motionWhy: A line-by-line reveal sets the beat of a three-part instruction.
